description: Normalize + SHA-256 hash PII identifier columns (email, phone, generic) in a DataFrame — a destination-agnostic building block for safe downstream activation or compliance/anonymization.

inputs.description: Input DataFrame containing one or more plaintext PII identifier columns

outputs.description: DataFrame with each listed identifier column normalized + SHA-256 hashed into a new '{column}{suffix}' column

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source` -- set exactly one.

source.label: Source
source.description: Pull rows directly via SQL instead of from an upstream asset: {kind: warehouse_query, resource_key: <registered resource> OR database_url_env_var: <env var>, sql: <query>}. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key` -- set exactly one.

column_identifiers.label: Column Identifiers
column_identifiers.description: Mapping of column name -> identifier type. Supported types: 'email', 'phone', 'generic'. Each listed column is normalized per its type then SHA-256 hashed into a new '{column}{hashed_column_suffix}' column. Columns not listed here pass through unchanged.

email_strip_all_whitespace.label: Email: Strip All Whitespace
email_strip_all_whitespace.description: Default (false): trim + lowercase -- the convention Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, X/Twitter, and Pinterest all document. Set true to additionally strip ALL whitespace (not just leading/trailing) before lowercasing -- LinkedIn's documented, broader rule.

phone_mode.label: Phone Normalization Mode
phone_mode.description: 'e164_with_plus': keep a leading '+' plus country-code digits only (Google Ads Customer Match, TikTok Custom Audiences, X/Twitter Tailored Audiences convention). 'digits_only_no_plus': strip the '+' and every non-digit character (Meta Custom Audiences, Pinterest Customer Lists convention). Pick whichever your downstream destination expects.

hashed_column_suffix.label: Hashed Column Suffix
hashed_column_suffix.description: Suffix appended to each identifier column's name to form its hashed output column name, e.g. 'email' -> 'email_hashed'.

drop_original_columns.label: Drop Original Columns
drop_original_columns.description: Drop the original plaintext identifier columns after hashing (default: true). Set false to KEEP plaintext columns for local debugging/testing only -- WARNING: enabling this in production defeats the purpose of hashing, since plaintext PII remains in the output DataFrame.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current date partition key (e.g. 'event_date', 'created_at').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current static partition value (e.g. 'customer_id', 'region').

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage: output column → list of upstream input columns it derives from. Defaults to each hashed column tracing back to its source column, e.g. {"email_hashed": ["email"]}.

include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (first 5 rows as a markdown table). Used by builder UIs to render asset shape without warehouse access. NOTE: since hashed values are the whole point, this preview only ever shows hashed digests (or passthrough/non-identifier columns) unless drop_original_columns is disabled.
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True. For long DataFrames (>10x preview_rows), a random sample is used so the preview reflects the data distribution; otherwise head() is used.
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.
description.label: Description

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on failure. Defines a RetryPolicy when set.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: PII Hasher
